name: drqv2-residual-options-pilot
interpretation: Exploratory one-frozen-driver feasibility work only. Neither iteration improved the reused development screen sufficiently; this is not multi-seed evidence, fresh confirmation, blind evaluation, model confirmation, or an official result.

development_partition.usage: Both option policies and the unchanged driver were evaluated on the same development cells. The grid is consumed tuning evidence, intentionally reused in v2, and not a fresh holdout. Historical pilot schedules are incomplete; the textual seed audit cannot prove global non-use.

iterations.decision_counter_correction: The original result field reports 16385 due to a duplicate counter increment. Episode totals (16374 completed + 10 interrupted) and per-option action counts both verify 16384 actual collector steps; see the run's counter-audit.json.

iterations.feedback_change: Require max(Q(non-KEEP))-Q(KEEP) to exceed a 3.4834041595458984 margin, calibrated as the 75th percentile on v1 training replay only.

execution_accounting.failed_implementation_smoke: runs/20260924-drqv2-residual-options-pilot/iteration-1/failure.json records a transition-accumulation integration error after two environment decisions and zero Q updates.
execution_accounting.training_runtime: Local CUDA training used Torch 2.11.0+cu128 on an RTX 5070 Ti. CPU development evaluation used local Torch 2.11.0+cu128, not the competition's pinned runtime.

verdict.reason: The first option policy tied the base finish count, with balanced paired wins/losses and lower progress. The margin-gated second policy reduced intervention frequency but lost two net finishes versus the same base on the development screen.
verdict.action: Stop this pilot. Do not run a third training attempt or reinterpret these consumed development cells as confirmation. Any future study requires a separately frozen protocol and independently audited new screen/confirmation cells.
verdict.deployment: Not integrated into agent.py or the submission/evaluator pipeline; not eligible or confirmed.
